name: org.townindex/directory
title: TownIndex
description: Local businesses on both US coasts, Alaska and Hawaii: search, hours, emergency service, errors

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local businesses on the East Coast, the West Coast, Alaska and Hawaii (Alaska, California, Connecticut, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Vermont, Virginia and Washington) by trade, problem, name and place, nearest first. Understands problems as the trade that fixes them ('no heat' = HVAC, 'overflowing toilet' = plumbers, 'car won't start' = towing). Returns 20 results a page with phone, address, website, open-now status when the hours are known, whether a contractor's state license was verified, and the TownIndex page url.

query.description: What and where in plain words: a trade, a problem or a business name, and a town or ZIP code. Examples: 'plumber in Wolcott', 'no heat 06114', 'pizza Hartford', 'locksmith Worcester MA'.

near_zip.description: The user's ZIP code: used to rank by distance when the query names no place.

open_now.description: Only businesses open right now (by their hours, their emergency hours, or on call). If none is known to be open, all matches are returned instead, with fallback set.

emergency_now.description: Only businesses taking emergency calls right now (24/7 emergency service or on call). If none is known, all matches are returned instead, with fallback set.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: One business in full: phone, address, website, opening hours and whether it's open now, holiday hours, emergency calls, services, towns it serves, state license numbers and expiry, and whether the owner has claimed the listing. Give either the id from search_businesses or a TownIndex page url.

tools.name: on_call_near
tools.description: Emergency service businesses whose owner has switched on 'on call' right now (for a few hours at a time), nearest first, within a distance of a ZIP code or a point. Few owners use it yet: when none is on call, use search_businesses with emergency_now, which also covers posted 24/7 emergency service.

zip.description: A ZIP code in a state we cover (CT, MA, RI, NH, VT, ME, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD, DC, VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, WA, OR, CA, AK or HI).

lat.description: Latitude, instead of a ZIP code.

tools.name: report_listing_issue
tools.description: Tell TownIndex that a listing is wrong: the business closed or moved, or its phone, hours or website are wrong. A person reviews every report before anything changes. Use it only for what you have good reason to believe (the user said so, a web page shows it, or a call didn't go through), and ask the user before sending it.

id.description: The business id from search_businesses or get_business.

basis.description: How you know: the user said so, a web page shows it, or a call to the listed number didn't go through.

message.description: What is wrong and, if known, what is right ("moved to 12 Main St", "the number is disconnected", "the website says closed since March"; a web page's address helps).
